description:
Get the main image of a specific product from Holded.

Args:
  - product_id (string): The product ID to get the main image for (required)
  - response_format ('json' | 'markdown'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  Product main image data (URL or base64 encoded).

product_id.description: The product ID to get the main image for

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data or 'markdown' for human-readable

name: holded_invoicing_get_product_image
title: Get Holded Product Main Image
